job.job_description:
We are seeking a highly skilled AI / LLM Engineer to design, build, and own production-grade AI systems that power enterprise operations. This role involves developing intelligent agent workflows, drift detection systems, alert correlation engines, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, automated documentation agents, and ChatOps solutions using modern LLM technologies.




The ideal candidate has hands-on experience building and deploying AI applications in production environments, with strong expertise in LangGraph, Python, Pydantic, RAG architectures, vector databases, and agent orchestration frameworks. This is an engineering-focused role requiring a strong emphasis on reliability, auditability, scalability, and measurable business outcomes.




Key Responsibilities

Design and develop LangGraph-based agent workflows and state machines with conditional routing, state persistence, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
Build intelligent drift detection agents for configuration, usage, compliance, and cost monitoring using structured and explainable outputs.
Develop alert correlation and event intelligence capabilities, including graph traversal, parent-child suppression, deduplication, alert clustering, and confidence scoring.
Design and implement enterprise-scale RAG pipelines, including chunking strategies, embedding selection, metadata filtering, retrieval optimization, and vector database design.
Build AI-powered documentation agents that generate structured technical documentation from source code repositories and engineering artifacts.
Develop and maintain ChatOps agents integrated with enterprise systems and knowledge repositories.
Implement structured output schemas using Pydantic and ensure deterministic, auditable AI responses.
Create evaluation frameworks, benchmark datasets, automated tests, and quality metrics for AI system performance.
Collaborate with backend, platform, cloud, and data engineering teams on API contracts and solution architecture.
Produce technical documentation covering design decisions, confidence scoring methodologies, thresholds, assumptions, and known limitations.
Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and production deployment activities.

Must-Have Skills & Experience

3+ years of experience building and deploying production AI/ML systems.
Hands-on experience with LangGraph, including workflow orchestration, state management, node/edge patterns, and conditional execution.
Strong Python development expertise.
Experience designing structured outputs using Pydantic or equivalent frameworks.
Proven experience building production-grade LLM applications and agentic workflows.
Strong understanding of prompt engineering, evaluation methodologies, and AI system testing.
Experience building deterministic and auditable AI workflows.
Hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems.
Experience with vector databases such as pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, or similar platforms.
Strong understanding of embeddings, chunking strategies, retrieval tuning, and metadata filtering.
Experience writing unit tests, integration tests, and evaluation suites for AI solutions.



Good to Have

LangSmith or similar LLM observability and tracing tools.
Experience with graph-based algorithms and NetworkX.
Alert correlation, incident management, or AIOps experience.
Re-ranking techniques for improving retrieval relevance.
Microsoft Teams Bot Framework development.
Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, and Azure DevOps integrations.
ServiceNow integrations and workflow automation.
Knowledge of SRE practices, DORA metrics, FinOps, or cloud governance.



Key Skills

LangGraph | Generative AI | LLMs | RAG | pgvector | Python | Pydantic | Agentic AI | Prompt Engineering | Vector Databases | Azure OpenAI | LangSmith | NetworkX | ServiceNow | ChatOps




Why Join Us?

Work on large-scale enterprise AI systems with real business impact.
Build production-ready AI solutions beyond prototypes and proof of concepts.
Own end-to-end design, development, testing, and deployment of modern AI platforms.
Collaborate with high-performing engineering, cloud, and data teams.
Opportunity to shape next-generation AI-driven operations and automation capabilities.
